These endpoints have their own block, use it instead: delete_message: action_message_delete, add_my_message_reaction: action_message_reaction_create, delete_my_message_reaction: action_message_reaction_delete, deprecated_create_pin: action_message_pin, deprecated_delete_pin: action_message_unpin, list_messages: action_message_list, bulk_delete_messages: action_message_bulk_delete, ban_user_from_guild: action_member_ban, unban_user_from_guild: action_member_unban, delete_guild_member: action_member_kick, add_guild_member_role: action_member_role_add, delete_guild_member_role: action_member_role_remove, create_guild_role: action_role_create, delete_channel: action_channel_delete, add_thread_member: action_thread_member_add, delete_thread_member: action_thread_member_remove, create_channel_invite: action_invite_create.
